text:
accumulate
Description
Terminates iRule processing until another another packet containing
additional data is received from the originating client. This
statement is useful with the
HTTP::collect
and
TCP::collect
commands, when not enough
data has been received to be successfully evaluated.
Syntax
accumulate
accumulate
Terminates iRule processing until another packet containing
additional data is received from the originating client.
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
if
{
[
TCP
::
payload
]
contains
"ABC"
}
{
pool
http_pool
}
elseif
{
[
TCP
::
collect
]
<
20
}
{
accumulate
}
else
{
discard
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ALL_EVENTS
